race.comment: COLD MIST (10) went to the lead in a new role last start and battled on fairly once headed to be defeated less than two lengths over today's trip at Nowra. Goes best for Quayde Krogh who is back aboard. Not out of the contest. ROYAL OVERTURE (8) closed steadily without threatening first-up over 1300m at Wangaratta. Lightly raced mare who will improve over an extra 100m with that run under the belt. KAYLA MARIE (7) debuted with a moderate third at Tumut recently. Can do better over this longer journey. Also expecting good improvement from MONEY BAGS (5) second up.
